about.title: About Us
about.desc: About SugoiTools: free online image, PDF, video, text and calculator tools that run entirely in your browser, with no sign-up.
about.html:
SugoiTools is a small collection of free online tools for everyday jobs: resizing a photo for Instagram, shrinking a file to fit an email, or turning a WEBP into a JPG.

Sugoi (すごい) is Japanese for amazing: free tools that just work.

Every tool runs in your own browser. Your files are never uploaded to a server, there is no sign-up, and the tools keep working on slow connections once the page has loaded.

There are 42 tools today, across images, PDFs, video, text, social media, calculators and everyday utilities, and we add new ones regularly.

Meet the developer

Hi, I'm Aditya Kumar, the developer behind SugoiTools.

I built SugoiTools because most free tool sites are slow, full of ads, and want you to upload your files. Every tool here runs right in your browser, so your photos, PDFs and videos never leave your device.

It's a one-person project, and I add new tools regularly. Have an idea or found a bug? I'd love to hear from you.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.desc: SugoiTools privacy policy: files are processed locally in your browser and never uploaded. No accounts, no cookies set by SugoiTools itself.
privacy.html:
Your files

Files you open in SugoiTools (images, PDFs and videos) are processed locally in your browser and are never uploaded to our servers or anyone else's. When you close or reload the page, they are gone.

Data we collect

SugoiTools has no accounts and does not ask for personal information. SugoiTools itself does not set cookies. Your theme choice (light or dark) is remembered in your browser's local storage, and never leaves your device.

Third-party services

Some tools load open-source code from public content delivery networks when you open them: the PDF tools load pdf-lib and PDF.js from jsDelivr, the video tools load Mediabunny from jsDelivr or unpkg, and the QR Code Generator loads qrcode-generator from jsDelivr. These requests fetch code only; your files are not sent with them. The YouTube Thumbnail Downloader loads thumbnail images directly from YouTube's image servers (img.youtube.com) for the video you enter. The hosting provider may keep standard server logs, such as IP addresses and pages requested.

Advertising

In future, this site may use Google AdSense to show ads. Google AdSense uses cookies to serve ads. Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this website or other websites. You can opt out of personalised advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings.

Changes

If this policy changes, the updated version will be posted on this page.
